email.body1:
Kim, saw Symetri scale fast in the U.S. through the Microdesk and Repro acquisitions on the way to #1 global Autodesk partner.

Growing the U.S. footprint that quickly, especially across government accounts, usually means more agencies and contractors in play than business development can personally cover. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Symetri off your expansion and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kim, quick follow-up for Symetri.

After back-to-back U.S. acquisitions, the government target list is far larger than the team that has to touch it, and most BD orgs cannot see how many meetings they need to actually cover it. The gap shows up late, and then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Symetri's government practice needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kim, last bit of proof for Symetri.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Symetri's reply rate likely compares to other technology resellers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Kim, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a government BD motion? I will tailor it to Symetri either way.
